observed_bottleneck: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 loads and reconstructs exactly on all three seeds, but each preparation assigns a different random spherical codebook and its macro score ranges from 0.441893056926007 to 0.531102062096459 (standard deviation 0.04100326143244739), with drd2_docking standard deviation 0.14883935107026078. Node n-b8f59c580ca4 additionally shows that the resulting local representation is inefficient, with 335,178 of 365,802 Parent seed-0 latent proposals decoding to the unchanged anchor. Representation siblings isolate why another likelihood or affine intervention is not the next test: n-ca3bd2057287 lowered heldout latent NLL on every seed yet lost 0.07334922775267033 paired macro score, while n-035412fc1948 changed contraction and lost 0.020383727828440668 on average. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore the Parent's uncontrolled per-seed codebook neighborhood basis, not exactness, training duration, or affine displacement scaling.
hypothesis: Use one seed-invariant deterministic spherical token codebook for every independently prepared SeqFlow artifact, removing preparation-seed-specific token-center geometry so the learned representations share a common discrete neighborhood basis and can vary only through the inherited corpus and optimizer stochasticity.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.
